ce_bugs.text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:47 — The add/remove mutation promises detach the follow-up refresh, so callers report success before the UI reload finishes and refresh failures become unhandled.
app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:35 — Pagination commits the new offset before the request succeeds, so a failed request labels the old member list as the new page.
app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:30 — Concurrent member fetches are not sequenced, allowing a slower stale response to overwrite a newer page or post-mutation refresh.

mrv_findings.text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members/remove_member — `params.require(:group_id)` but routes.rb declares `delete "members"`/`put "members"` as bare collection-block routes generating `:id`, not `:group_id`; every request raises ActionController::ParameterMissing, breaking add/remove-member entirely. Confidence 90, P0.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:17 — `Discourse.computed.propertyEqual("currentPage","totalPages")` references a namespace/helper that doesn't exist anywhere in the codebase (Ember exposes `Em.computed.equal`), throwing at module load and breaking the whole controller. Confidence 75, P0.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb remove_member — `group.users.delete(user_id)` passes a raw Integer instead of a User record/id array to ActiveRecord collection#delete, likely raising AssociationTypeMismatch instead of removing the membership. Confidence 60, P1.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js and discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6 — `model.findMembers()` called fire-and-forget in setupController (no `return`/`.then()`), so route no longer awaits member fetch before render (behavior regression from previous afterModel blocking). Confidence 60, P3.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members — public JSON response shape changed from bare array to {members, meta} with no versioning; any existing client/theme parsing the old array shape breaks silently. Confidence 100, P1.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb#remove_member — `group.users.delete(user_id)` mutates the join table immediately outside of `group.save`'s outcome; save failure reports error after mutation already happened, giving false success/failure semantics with no transaction. Confidence 100, P2.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb#add_members — `usernames.split(",").each { User.find_by_username }` is an N+1 query loop instead of a single batched `where(username_lower: [...])`, unbounded by input size (DoS vector via large usernames param). Confidence 100, P2.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb#add_members — no duplicate/idempotency guard on `group.add(user)`; no transaction wraps the loop, so a mid-loop failure leaves partial membership applied with no rollback. Confidence 75, P2.

discourse/models/group.js#findMembers — return type changed from always-a-Promise (`Ember.RSVP.resolve([])` for empty name) to sometimes `undefined`, breaking `.then()`-chaining callers and removing the "wait before render" guarantee. Confidence 75, P2.

discourse/models/group.js — pagination/UI state (limit/offset/user_count/members) mixed onto the same ORM-savable Discourse.Group domain object, risking stale pagination state leaking across reused model instances. Confidence 50, P3.
app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members — unbounded `limit` param with no upper-bound clamp, allowing large unbounded query/serialization pass per request. Confidence 75, P3.

discourse/models/group.js#removeMember + findMembers — stale `user_count` used to clamp offset when refetching after removal; removing the last member of the last page leaves the UI showing an empty page instead of stepping back, uncaught server-side too. Confidence 75, P1.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members — no spec coverage at all for the paginated public endpoint (meta.total/limit/offset correctness, boundary offset, uniform pagination for automatic vs non-automatic groups). Confidence 90, P1.
app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-23 — limit/offset fully client-controlled with no bounds/sanity checking, untested for negative/zero/huge values. Confidence 75, P2.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb#add_members — no `.strip` on split usernames (whitespace after comma silently fails lookup), no dedup, and always returns success_json regardless of how many usernames actually resolved — TODO comment confirms unfinished UX feedback path. app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb update/destroy/add_members/remove_member — `Group.find(params...)` unrescued; nonexistent group_id produces unhandled 500 instead of 404/422, untested. Confidence 75, P2.
